opportunities.title: Known cyclic-order depolarizing-channel reproduction
opportunities.evidence:
Chiribella/Wilson/Chau cyclic depolarizing construction: The study owner identifies this paper as direct prior art for the selected construction. No new discovery is claimed.
2025 silicon-photonic experimental prior art: The study owner identifies prior experimental work and reports F=0.712 +/- 0.013. The integration adapter does not independently establish this experimental claim.
Independent finite exact Kraus enumeration: N=4, 256 Kraus tuples: p=7/16, F=5/7, Choi PT minimum=-1/14. Scope is a known mathematical construction, not hardware or channel capacity.
Rejected weak heterogeneous variation: A small full-rank replacement-channel variation preserves the strict entanglement margin by continuity. This variation does not earn a substantive discovery claim.

opportunity.title: Known cyclic-order depolarizing-channel reproduction
opportunity.hypothesis: Superpose cyclic orders of four completely depolarizing qubit channels and herald transmission preserving entanglement; investigate a high-noise quantum link. Known prior art; rejected as a flagship and venture.
opportunity.metric: Exact known N=4 herald probability, conditional fidelity and Choi partial-transpose witness; novelty rejection retained.
opportunity.target: Reproduce p=7/16, F=5/7 and PT minimum=-1/14 while preserving no-discovery and no-qualified-venture status.
opportunity.evidence_needed: Independent local exact Kraus enumeration supports a known result; hardware, resource-matched comparison and commercial acceptance remain untested.
